problem: The school library had 84 new bookmarks in a box. Mr Adeyemi gave 37 of them to one class and 28 to another. How many bookmarks remain in the box?
follow_up_questions: A parent donates 50 more bookmarks. How many bookmarks are in the box now?
At the book fair, 45 bookmarks are handed out. How many are left in the box?

problem: How many seed packets are still in the garden club's basket? The club started the season with 84 packets, then planted 37 in the vegetable beds and 28 along the fence.
follow_up_questions: Grandma Rosa sends 50 packets from her own garden. How many packets are in the basket now?
In autumn the club plants 45 packets. How many packets are left in the basket?

problem: There are 9 goldfish still swimming in the pet shop's big tank after 7 were sold on Monday. A plastic diver stands among the pebbles. How many goldfish did the tank hold before Monday?
follow_up_questions: On Tuesday the shop sells 5 more goldfish. How many are left in the tank?
A supplier delivers 12 goldfish. How many goldfish does the tank hold now?

problem: How many sheep were in Farmer Oduya's pen before market day? He sold 7 sheep at the market, and 9 are still in the pen. The pen gate squeaks loudly.
follow_up_questions: Next week he sells 5 more. How many sheep remain in the pen?
His neighbour brings over 12 sheep. How many sheep are in the pen now?

problem: At the picnic, Ama's 4 cousins ate 13 of the sandwiches in the cooler, which left 8 inside. How many sandwiches were in the cooler at first?
follow_up_questions: Ama's mum puts in 10 more sandwiches. How many sandwiches are in the cooler now?

problem: How many crayons were in the tub? The pupils at desk 6 used up 13 crayons during art, and 8 crayons are still in the tub.
follow_up_questions: The teacher drops 10 new crayons into the tub. How many crayons does the tub hold now?

problem: A baker made 70 loaves this morning. The shop closes at 5, and right now 23 loaves are left on the shelves. How many loaves have been sold?
follow_up_questions: A school takes 9 loaves for its lunch. How many loaves are left?
The baker bakes 32 more loaves for tomorrow. How many loaves are ready?

problem: Find how many books were borrowed today. The library opened with 70 books on the new-books cart, and by now only 23 remain. The library has 3 floors.
follow_up_questions: A teacher borrows 9 more for her class. How many books remain on the cart?
The librarian adds 32 books for tomorrow. How many books will be on the cart?

problem: Mrs Chen took 24 pencils from the supply cupboard for her class, and 15 pencils were still in the cupboard. Her classroom is on floor 2. How many pencils had been in the cupboard?
follow_up_questions: Mrs Chen returns 9 pencils she did not need. How many pencils are in the cupboard now?
Then she takes 11 pencils for a test. How many pencils are in the cupboard?

problem: A hotel cleaner carried 24 towels from the linen closet to the rooms. The closet still has 15 towels on its shelves, and the hotel has 8 floors. Work out how many towels were in the closet before she started.
follow_up_questions: She brings 9 unused towels back. How many towels are in the closet now?
Later she takes 11 towels for the pool. How many towels does the closet hold?

problem: Grandpa Ilya sawed 16 planks from the pile to build a new fence, and 17 planks are still in the pile. How many planks were in the pile before he started?
follow_up_questions: He uses 9 more planks for a gate. How many planks are left in the pile?
A truck delivers 25 planks. How many planks are in the pile now?

problem: How many oranges were in the basket at first? Lina squeezed 16 oranges for juice, and the basket still has 17.
follow_up_questions: She squeezes 9 more for breakfast. How many oranges are in the basket now?
Then her uncle brings 25 oranges from the market. How many oranges are in the basket?

problem: A school has 26 tablets for pupils to borrow. At the moment, 9 of them are being used in class. How many tablets are free to borrow?
The town owns 26 rental bikes, and riders are out on 9 of them. What is the number of bikes still waiting at the station?
Two sisters at the flower market sold roses from a bucket that held 52. When only 18 remained, they stopped to count. How many roses did the sisters sell altogether?
follow_up_questions: Their dad brings 24 more roses from the van. How many roses are in the bucket now?
A bride orders 15 roses. How many roses are left in the bucket?

problem: What is the combined number of comics two shop clerks sold? At the start of the day the comic rack had 52 comics, and now just 18 are on it.
follow_up_questions: A delivery adds 24 comics to the rack. How many comics are on the rack now?
A collector buys 15 of them. How many comics remain on the rack?

problem: Mr Haddad's classroom started the term with 60 glue sticks in a tub. The classroom window looks out on a pond. By the end of term, 22 glue sticks were left. How many glue sticks had the pupils used?
How many seed packets did visitors take? A garden centre put 60 free seed packets by the door, and when it closed only 22 were left. A robin sang on the fence all afternoon.
A school librarian has 21 new picture books. A teacher asks to borrow 6 of them for her class. After she does, how many new picture books are still in the library?
Kemal's toy shop has 21 kites. How many kites remain once a family buys 6 for a beach trip?
A gardener has 45 tulip bulbs in a sack. She means to plant 28 of them this afternoon. If she does, how many bulbs will stay in the sack?
How many stamps will Arjun have left if he sticks 28 of his 45 stamps on party invitations, as he plans?
A bead box in the craft room held 85 beads in the morning. The craft room has a big sunny window. By noon the children had threaded 57 beads onto bracelets. How many beads remain in the box?
follow_up_questions: Ms Novak tips 40 more beads into the box. How many beads are in the box now?

problem: Children have used 57 of the 85 sheets of coloured paper in the art cupboard. The cupboard door has a rainbow sticker on it. What number of sheets is left in the cupboard?
follow_up_questions: The teacher adds a pack of 40 sheets. How many sheets of coloured paper are in the cupboard now?

problem: The farm stand picks 72 ears of corn each morning, and 38 ears were still there at closing today. How many ears of corn did the stand sell in all today?
follow_up_questions: The farmer gives 15 of the leftover ears to a neighbour. How many leftover ears does she still have?

problem: At the fair, a balloon seller blew up 72 balloons before opening. What is the total he sold today, if 38 balloons were still tied to his cart at the end?
follow_up_questions: He gives 15 of the leftover balloons to children from a hospital. How many leftover balloons does he still have?

problem: Ayesha gives out one sticker for every good deed in her class. She opened a tub of 94 stickers on Monday and had given out 57 by Friday. How many stickers are still in the tub?
How many nails are left in the box? A carpenter started a new box of 94 nails and hammered in 57 of them while building a doghouse.
Ravi keeps his marbles in a bag. He lost 15 of them at school, and if you take that away from what he had, you get the 20 still in his bag. How many marbles did he have before he lost any?
follow_up_questions: Ravi loses 6 more marbles. How many are left in his bag?

problem: How many crackers were in the tin at first? Subtract the 15 crackers Mia shared with her friends, and you are left with the 20 crackers still in the tin.
follow_up_questions: Mia shares 6 more crackers. How many crackers are left in the tin?

problem: Nurse Fatima keeps bandages in a cabinet. On Monday it held 64, but on Wednesday morning just 27 were left. How many bandages did she use on Monday and Tuesday?
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday, she uses 18 more bandages. How many are left?
A box of 48 bandages arrives. How many bandages are in the cabinet now?

problem: Find how many bags of birdseed the pet shop sold on Monday and Tuesday. Its storeroom had 64 bags on Monday morning, but only 27 by Wednesday morning.
follow_up_questions: During Wednesday the shop sells 18 more bags. How many bags are left?
A truck delivers 48 bags. How many bags are in the storeroom now?

problem: A painter's big barrel of white paint is almost empty. She used 36 litres on Friday and 28 litres on Saturday, and now 19 litres are left. How many litres were in the barrel before Friday?
follow_up_questions: She pours in a new can of 50 litres. How many litres are in the barrel now?
On Sunday she uses 32 litres. How many litres are left?
If Monday's job needs 25 litres, how many litres will remain after Monday?

problem: How many buckets of water were in the farm's tank before Friday? The cows drank 36 buckets on Friday and 28 buckets on Saturday, and 19 buckets are left in the tank.
follow_up_questions: Farmer Lindiwe adds 50 buckets of water to the tank. How many buckets are in it now?
The cows drink 32 buckets on Sunday. How many buckets are left?
Monday's drinking will take 25 buckets. How many buckets will remain after Monday?

problem: There are 78 returned books on the library cart. The librarian puts 49 of them back on the shelves. Her cardigan has big red buttons. How many books are still on the cart?
The farmer's crate holds 78 apples. Before the market, his son loads 49 of them into the van. The van smells of hay. How many apples stay in the crate?
Zainab expects to hand out 47 flyers at the morning assembly. She printed 92 flyers for the school fair. If her guess is right, how many flyers will she have left for the afternoon?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon she hands out 38 flyers. How many flyers are left at the end of the day?

problem: How many bags of popcorn will be left for the evening show? The cinema popped 92 bags in the morning and expects the afternoon show to sell 47 of them.
follow_up_questions: The evening show sells 38 bags. How many bags are left when the cinema closes?

problem: During practice, players took 26 tennis balls out of Coach Petra's bag, and now only 13 balls are inside. How many balls were in the bag before practice?
follow_up_questions: She adds 30 new balls to the bag. How many balls are in the bag now?
Then the players take out 17 more balls. How many are left in the bag?

problem: Before school started, how many apples were in the fruit bowl? The children took 26 apples at snack time, and now the bowl has just 13.
follow_up_questions: The cook puts 30 apples in the bowl. How many apples does the bowl hold now?
After lunch the children take 17 apples. How many apples are left?

problem: Farmer Rosa began the week with 48 bales of hay. Her farm has 4 tractors. She now has 29 bales. How many bales of hay has she used?
follow_up_questions: She uses 8 more bales. How many bales are left?
A truck brings 36 bales. How many bales does she have now?

problem: How many sheets of stickers has the art teacher handed out? She started the term with 48 sheets and is down to 29. Her art room has 6 big tables.
follow_up_questions: She hands out 8 more sheets. How many sheets are left?
A parcel arrives with 36 sheets. How many sheets of stickers does she have now?

problem: Leon's chocolate bar breaks into 8 squares. He gives one square to each of his 3 cousins and keeps the rest. How many squares does Leon keep?
follow_up_questions: Leon eats 2 of his squares. How many squares does he have left?

problem: How many crayons stay in the box after Ms Diaz lends one to each of her 3 helpers? The box held 8 crayons.
follow_up_questions: Then she takes 2 of the crayons to draw a poster. How many crayons are left in the box?

problem: On Saturday the toy shop sold 21 of the 36 yo-yos it had in the morning. How many yo-yos were still in the shop that evening?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday a supplier brought 10 more yo-yos. How many yo-yos did the shop have then?

problem: Find how many tickets the zoo booth still had after selling 21 of its 36 tickets for the train ride.
follow_up_questions: Then the manager printed 10 extra tickets. How many tickets did the booth have now?

problem: At the school bake sale, Farida's table had 2 trays of brownies and 40 cupcakes she had baked. When the sale ended, 13 cupcakes had not been sold. How many cupcakes did she sell?
follow_up_questions: She gave 5 of the unsold cupcakes to the teachers. How many unsold cupcakes did she still have?
Then she took 6 more cupcakes out of a tin and put them on the table. How many cupcakes were on the table after that?

problem: How many bunches of flowers did Mr Kowalski sell at the market? He brought 40 bunches in his van along with 7 pots of herbs, and 13 bunches were not sold.
follow_up_questions: He gave 5 of the unsold bunches to a care home. How many unsold bunches did he still have?
Then he picked 6 fresh bunches from his garden and added them to the stall. How many bunches were on his stall after that?

problem: After football training, 54 cones were still in good shape, but 38 had been crushed and went in the bin. How many cones did the team have before training?
What number of paper cups did the scouts bring to the bake sale? They used 38 cups for hot chocolate, and 54 cups were still unused at the end.
Runners grabbed 28 water bottles altogether from the finish-line table, which had held 45 bottles before the race. How many bottles did the table have left?
follow_up_questions: Later 9 more runners each took a bottle. How many bottles were on the table then?

problem: How many maps were left in the museum's rack after visitors took 28 maps in total from the 45 it held in the morning?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon, 9 more visitors each took one map. How many maps were in the rack then?

problem: To pay for its camping trip, a scout troop is selling 50 boxes of biscuits. One week in, 23 boxes are still waiting for buyers. How many boxes has the troop sold?
follow_up_questions: In the second week the troop sells another 15 boxes. How many boxes are still waiting for buyers?
At the end, the troop gives 6 of those boxes to a food bank. How many boxes are left over?
How many of the troop's boxes were sold or given away in the end?

problem: How many raffle tickets had the football club sold, a week after printing 50 of them, if 23 still had no buyer?
follow_up_questions: Over the next week the club sold 15 more. How many tickets still had no buyer?
On match day, 6 of those tickets were given free to the referees. How many tickets were left over?
In the end, how many of the club's tickets had been sold or given away?

problem: A water stall at the football match sold 47 bottles from its cart, and when the final whistle blew there were 26 bottles still on it. The home team wore green shirts. How many bottles were on the cart when the match began?
follow_up_questions: After the match, 8 bottles that had leaked were thrown away. How many bottles were left on the cart?
For the next match, the stall wants 40 bottles on the cart. How many bottles must it add?

problem: How many pies were on the counter before the fair opened? By closing time, the bakery stall had sold 47 pies and still had 26 on the counter. A juggler performed beside the stall all day.
follow_up_questions: The baker threw away 8 pies that had been dropped. How many pies were left on the counter?
Tomorrow the baker wants 40 pies on the counter. How many pies must she add?

problem: A boat chugged past, and 18 of the twenty-four ducks on the pond flew off to the reeds. How many ducks stayed on the pond?
follow_up_questions: Then a family of 7 ducks landed on the water. How many ducks were on the pond now?

problem: How many people were still in the pool after the whistle blew? There were 24 swimmers in the pool, and 18 of them climbed out for a break.
follow_up_questions: Then a lifeguard let 7 swimmers from the queue jump in. How many swimmers were in the pool now?

problem: Along the river, 31 people were fishing on Saturday morning. Some packed up and left, and by lunchtime 14 were still fishing; 2 of them had caught a fish. How many people had left?
How many kites had come down? At noon, 31 kites were flying over the beach. An hour later, 14 were still up, and 5 of those were shaped like dragons.
On a rainy Saturday, families borrowed 26 board games from the library's shelf of 42 games. What is the total number of games left on the shelf?
follow_up_questions: On Monday, 11 games were returned. How many games were on the shelf then?

problem: The sports cupboard held 42 footballs before break. Pupils took out 26 to play with. Find the total number of footballs still in the cupboard.
follow_up_questions: After break, 11 footballs were put back. How many footballs were in the cupboard then?

problem: Making crowns for the class party used up most of the art club's 34 sheets of gold paper; only 9 sheets were left. How many sheets were used for the crowns?
follow_up_questions: Mr Lindgren then gave the club a pack of 20 sheets. How many sheets did the club have now?
The club used 12 of them for a banner. How many sheets were left?
Work out how many sheets the club used on the crowns and the banner together.

problem: How many shells did Freya glue onto her sandcastle picture? She had 34 shells in her bucket and 9 were left when she finished.
follow_up_questions: Her brother gave her 20 more shells. How many shells did she have then?
She used 12 of them on a frame. How many shells were left?
How many shells did she use on the picture and the frame altogether?

problem: Only 23 cups of flour are left in the baker's sack after she used 16 cups to make bread. The bread smelled wonderful. How many cups of flour were in the sack before she baked?
follow_up_questions: Then the baker, Aditi, used 8 cups to make pancakes. How many cups are in the sack now?

problem: How many beads were in Lucy's jar before she made a necklace? The necklace took 16 beads, and the jar still has 23. Her necklace is the colour of the sea.
follow_up_questions: Lucy then used 8 beads for a ring. How many beads are in the jar now?

problem: Shoppers bought 38 flower pots at the garden centre on Saturday and 29 on Sunday. The centre had 85 pots on Friday night. How many pots did it have left after the weekend?
follow_up_questions: On Monday the owner unpacked 50 new pots. How many pots were there then?
By Friday the centre had sold 45 of them. How many pots were left at the end of Friday?

problem: How many comics were still on the stand after the weekend? The newsagent had 85 comics on Friday evening, then sold 38 on Saturday and 29 on Sunday.
follow_up_questions: On Monday 50 new comics arrived and went on the stand. How many comics were on the stand then?
The newsagent sold 45 of them by Friday. How many comics were left at the end of Friday?

problem: Raffle tickets cost 3 coins each at the school fair. The roll started with 24 tickets, and only 7 were left after an hour. How many tickets had been sold?
How many slices of melon did Nkechi hand out? She cut a melon into 24 slices and had 7 left after the football match. Her team scored 4 goals.
At the water park, 9 children were still waiting in line for the slide after 12 had already gone down. How many children were in line to begin with?
follow_up_questions: Then 6 more children joined the line. How many were waiting now?

problem: How many people were in the queue at the bakery when it opened? The baker has served 12 people, and 9 people are still waiting.
follow_up_questions: Then 6 more people join the queue. How many people are waiting now?

problem: For the river festival, the village made 74 paper lanterns. It floated 27 down the river on the opening night and 19 more on the closing night. How many lanterns were left?
follow_up_questions: The children made 15 new lanterns for next year. How many lanterns does the village have now?
Each festival needs 46 lanterns. How many more lanterns must the village make?

problem: How many water balloons were left after the summer party? Kofi filled 74 balloons; the children threw 27 in the first game and 19 more in the second.
follow_up_questions: Kofi filled 15 new balloons. How many balloons does he have now?
The next party needs 46 balloons. How many more must Kofi fill?

problem: To make room for a dance floor, the wedding staff carried away some of the 60 chairs in the garden. Now 44 chairs are left. How many chairs did they carry away?
follow_up_questions: At the wedding, 39 guests sat down, one per chair. How many chairs were empty?
Then 8 more guests arrived late. How many of the late guests had to stand?
How many guests were at the wedding altogether?

problem: How many folding seats were packed away? For the town meeting, 60 seats were set out in the hall, and after making space for a stage, 44 were left.
follow_up_questions: On the evening of the meeting, 39 people came, each taking one seat. How many seats stayed empty?
Then 8 more people came in late. How many of those late people had to stand?
How many people came to the meeting altogether?

problem: Only 28 children reached the top of the hill on the class hike, because 13 got tired and turned back halfway. The path was rocky and steep. How many children set off on the hike?
follow_up_questions: At the top, 9 of the children ate their sandwiches. How many of them did not eat a sandwich?

problem: How many fans were at the football match at the start? In the second half, 13 fans went home because of the rain. The pitch turned to mud. The other 28 fans stayed until the final whistle.
follow_up_questions: After the match, 9 of those fans asked the players for autographs. How many of them did not ask?

problem: Pupils threw out 35 snapped crayons on Monday and another 28 on Tuesday. Before that, the art room tin held 90 crayons. How many crayons were left in the tin?
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday the teacher added a new box of 24 crayons. How many crayons were in the tin then?
How many crayons were thrown out on Monday and Tuesday together?

problem: How many bags of rice were left in the food bank's storeroom? It held 90 bags at the start of the week. Families took 35 bags on Monday and 28 bags on Tuesday.
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday a church brought 24 bags. How many bags were in the storeroom then?
How many bags did families take on Monday and Tuesday?

problem: Surfers rented boards from the beach hut all morning. It opened at 10 o'clock with 26 surfboards, and by lunch just 8 were left. How many surfboards were rented out?
How many laptops had pupils borrowed? When the library opened at 7, its cart held 26 laptops; by noon just 8 were still on it.
Mr Osei's class ate 17 cupcakes at the end-of-term party and left 8 in the box. How many cupcakes had Mr Osei brought?
follow_up_questions: He gave 3 of the leftover cupcakes to the school cook. How many cupcakes were in the box then?

problem: How many dumplings did Grandma Mei make? At dinner the family ate 17 dumplings, and 8 were left on the plate.
follow_up_questions: Grandma gave 3 of the leftover dumplings to the neighbour. How many dumplings were on the plate after that?

problem: The horses drank 25 buckets from a trough that a farmer had filled with 64 buckets of water over 2 weeks. How many buckets of water were left in the trough?
follow_up_questions: The next day the cows drank 18 buckets. How much water was in the trough after that?
Rain overnight then added 30 buckets. How many buckets were in the trough in the morning?
The trough holds 80 buckets when full. How many more buckets can it take?

problem: How many litres of juice were left in the big cooler? For the 4 races on sports day, the school poured 64 litres of orange juice into the cooler, and the runners drank 25 litres.
follow_up_questions: At lunch the teachers drank 18 litres. How much juice was in the cooler after that?
A parent then added 30 litres. How many litres were in the cooler?
The cooler holds 80 litres when full. How many more litres can it take?

problem: Grandpa Tomas is fixing the bathroom wall with tiles from a box of 96. When the first weekend is over, he counts 58 tiles left in the box. How many tiles has he used so far?
follow_up_questions: The second weekend he uses 37 tiles. How many tiles are still in the box?
How many tiles has he used over both weekends?

problem: How many beads had the craft club already used? The club opened a tub of 96 beads, and after its first meeting 58 beads remained in the tub.
follow_up_questions: At the second meeting, the club used 37 beads. How many beads were still in the tub?
Over the two meetings, how many beads did the club use?

problem: Painting the school mural left the art class with 14 fewer paintbrushes, since some got ruined. There are 19 brushes now. How many brushes did the class have before the mural?
follow_up_questions: The class then bought a pack of 12 brushes. How many brushes does it have now?

problem: How many eggs were in the farm basket before breakfast? Breakfast left the basket with 14 fewer eggs, and now 19 eggs are in it.
follow_up_questions: The hens then laid 12 more eggs, which went into the basket. How many eggs are in the basket now?

problem: The children at the birthday party popped 42 of the sixty balloons tied to the gate. How many balloons were still tied there?
How many cookies were left in the jar after the sleepover, if it held 60 at bedtime and the children ate 42 during the night?
Wasps buzzed around the apple press at the harvest festival. A family had 85 apples to press into juice, and by noon 37 were still in the basket. How many apples had they pressed?
follow_up_questions: Every 4 apples made one bottle of juice. How many bottles did the family make?
They sold 9 of the bottles by lunchtime. How many bottles were not sold yet?

problem: How many oranges did the cooks squeeze? The school kitchen had 85 oranges for the breakfast club, and after the morning 37 oranges were left. Orange peel makes the whole kitchen smell sweet.
follow_up_questions: It took 4 oranges to fill one glass. How many glasses of juice did the cooks make?
The children drank 9 of the glasses before the bell. How many glasses were not drunk yet?

problem: Mrs Ito kept 6 rubbish grabbers in her car and gave the other 14 to volunteers at the beach clean-up. How many grabbers did she have?
follow_up_questions: Later, 5 of the volunteers' grabbers broke. How many of the volunteers' grabbers still worked?

problem: How many paintbrushes were in the jar at the art workshop? Pedro handed out 14 brushes to the children and kept the remaining 6 for himself.
follow_up_questions: Later, 5 of the children's brushes lost their bristles. How many of the children's brushes could still be used?

problem: Of the 48 paper chains the class made for its party, 19 snapped while being hung up. The party hall had 2 tables of food. How many chains were still good?
follow_up_questions: The class made 15 new chains. How many good chains did they have now?
During the party, 6 chains were pulled down and torn. How many good chains were left?
The teacher wants 50 chains for the next party. How many more chains does the class need to make?

problem: How many bird boxes were still usable? The scout troop has 4 patrols, and together they built 48 bird boxes, but a storm wrecked 19 of them.
follow_up_questions: The scouts built 15 new bird boxes. How many usable boxes did they have now?
Squirrels then chewed through 6 boxes. How many usable boxes were left?
The park wants 50 bird boxes. How many more do the scouts need to build?

problem: Mr Dube sells scarves at football matches. He brought 82 to Saturday's match and took 37 home again. How many scarves did he sell?
follow_up_questions: Each scarf cost 2 dollars. How much money did the scarves he sold bring in?

problem: How many keyrings did the museum shop sell on Saturday? It opened with 82 keyrings, and at closing time Ms Achebe found 37 on the hook.
follow_up_questions: Every keyring cost 2 dollars. How much money did the sold keyrings make?

problem: Young swimmers took floats from the basket once their lesson began, so it held 34 floats less than before. Now there are 15 floats in it. How many floats were in the basket at first?
follow_up_questions: When the lesson ended, 29 floats were put back in the basket. How many floats were in the basket then?
How many floats were still missing?

problem: How many helmets did the bike shed hold at first? Once the cycling lesson began, the shed had 34 fewer helmets than before, and 15 helmets were still on the hooks.
follow_up_questions: After the lesson, children hung 29 helmets back up. How many helmets were in the shed then?
How many helmets were still missing?

problem: Nadia's craft table had 22 glue sticks. Her friends borrowed 15 of them for a poster. How many glue sticks were left on the table?
What number of eggs remained in the hen house after the farmer collected 15 of the 22 eggs laid this morning?
Leila came home from the park picnic with 12 cookies left. The picnic blanket had red and white squares. She had packed 30 cookies to share with her friends. How many did she share?
follow_up_questions: At home, her grandmother baked 7 more cookies for her. How many cookies did she have then?

problem: How many marbles did Bruno trade away at school? He packed 30 marbles in his bag in the morning and came back with 12. His school bag has a dinosaur on it.
follow_up_questions: His uncle gave him 7 marbles that evening. How many marbles did Bruno have then?

problem: Farmer Bea's cows ate 58 hay bales during one cold month, which left her with 36 bales. How many bales did she have when the cold month began?
follow_up_questions: Then a truck delivered 45 more bales. How many bales did she have after the delivery?
The next cold spell used 70 bales. How many bales were left after that?

problem: How many sandbags did the town have before the flood? Workers piled 58 sandbags along the river, and 36 sandbags were left in the yard.
follow_up_questions: A lorry then brought 45 more sandbags. How many sandbags were in the yard after the delivery?
The next flood used 70 sandbags. How many were left after that flood?

problem: Omar and his 3 friends made 31 paper planes to fly from the hill. On that windy afternoon, 17 planes crashed into a pond and were ruined. How many planes could still fly?
follow_up_questions: They made 9 new planes. How many planes could fly now?
Then 5 planes got stuck in a tree. How many planes could still fly?
How many planes did they make altogether?

problem: How many snowmen were still standing? Over the weekend, the 4 children on Elm Street built 31 snowmen in the park, but 17 of them melted in the sun.
follow_up_questions: They built 9 new snowmen. How many snowmen were standing now?
Then a dog knocked over 5 snowmen. How many snowmen were still standing?
How many snowmen did the children build altogether?

problem: By the end of the campfire night, 19 of the 45 marshmallows the leader bought were still in the bag. How many marshmallows had been eaten?
follow_up_questions: The leader gave 10 of the leftover marshmallows to the cook. How many were left in the bag?

problem: How many candles were used at the lantern festival? The organisers ordered 45 candles, and after the evening 19 were left in the box.
follow_up_questions: They gave 10 of the leftover candles to the village hall. How many candles were left in the box?

problem: The art class used 57 tiles on its fish mosaic. Take those away from the bucket and just 36 tiles are left. Before the mosaic, how many tiles were in the bucket?
follow_up_questions: Next the class used 28 tiles for a bird mosaic. How many tiles were left in the bucket?
How many tiles did the two mosaics use in all?

problem: How many pegs did the tent bag hold before camp was set up? Subtract the 57 pegs the scouts hammered in for the big tent, and 36 pegs are left in the bag.
